verdict.what: a Japanese-style teahouse or townhouse with a layered dark-tile roof
verdict.style: Japanese traditional, Edo-era wooden house with a stone plinth
verdict.summary: The Japanese character reads well with the dark wood, stone plinth, lanterns and flared eaves, but the roof is so heavy and deep that it looks like a lid on a shallow box, and a stray stone block on the left eave and an odd tall post on the right side need tidying before it goes in a street.
